timing_definition: paired native/middleware I/O, alternating N M M N order; generate through complete consumption, result retrieval and response close; real SDK parsing over immediate local HTTP; no tracing/network/server waits; default GC
input_definition: identical native supported history, images, schemas, tool calls/results and signed reasoning; typed fixtures built and encoder provenance removed outside timing; target SDK request bytes must be identical; returned native vs typed formats differ, so stream event counts are reported separately
probe_definition: separate warm tracemalloc and bounded cache snapshots; excludes fixtures and client construction, includes result and HTTP observations; not RSS; four-way response barrier proves overlap; two warmup batches
